messages:
maria: Quick check — vendor emailed saying 24 ephemeral A100 slots are available in us-west2 for next-week demos. Need to reconcile with our quota/reserved pools. @simon can you confirm if those are consumable by the 'demo' tenant? Also any short-term credits to extend to Tue/Wed? cc: @ashley

simon: I don't see that allocation in our quotas yet. Can you paste the vendor allocation id so I can look it up?

maria: allocation id: ALLOC-2091-NUKE. Vendor mentioned a PDF with details (can't attach here). They said 'tenant-bound' but wording was vague.

vendor-bot: Notification from AcmeCloud: Allocation ALLOC-2091 assigned to account redwood-prod, expires 2024-04-18T23:59Z. Slots: 24 x A100. Tags: ephemeral, demo-access. Link: https://acmecloud.example/alloc/ALLOC-2091

simon: OK looks like account-level. We normally require project-level bindings for demo tenants. @leo can we map these into demo pool or do we need to borrow from reserved capacity?

leo: We can map the allocation if vendor provides a project-level service account (SA). Otherwise it's account-wide and we'd have to do a manual borrow from reserved pools — that takes ~24h plus billing sign-off. @ashley FYI.

ashley: Billing will approve short-term borrows up to 48h for demo-tagged allocations and usage under 200 total GPU-hours. Need a cost-center tag and spend ticket.

maria: I'll ask vendor for a project SA. Quick ops question — to verify ephemeral slots on our side, what's the exact project id I should query?

simon: Use project `redwood-demo-usw2`. Example: `gcloud compute regions describe us-west2 --project=redwood-demo-usw2` to see accelerators (or provider-specific CLI).

maria: Ran the check, no A100s listed yet — allocation probably not bound. Pinging vendor support for SA.

vendor-bot: Support reply: "We can provision a project SA, pending signed SLA. ETA ~4 hours."

leo: If SLA will take >2h we should schedule a fallback: borrow 12 A100 from reserved pool to cover Monday morning demos.

simon: Agreed. @maria can you confirm peak demo window and concurrent slot needs? Also include retention/cost policy.

maria: Peak is Mon 09:00–13:00 PST, expecting 12 concurrent sessions, each needs ~1xA100. Prefer vendor allocation but fallback needs 12 reserved. Can we do incremental: borrow 12 now, vendor supplies remainder when SA is ready?

ashley: Billing ok with incremental borrow. Please create a spend ticket with cost code DEMO-Q2 and attach it to the borrow request.

maria: Created ticket #SPEND-7868 and attached DEMO-Q2. Pinging vendor for SA email and SLA. Also looping @ops-oncall to prevent autoscaler surprises.

ops-oncall: Noted — I'll set max nodes to 16 for demo cluster during the window and suspend autoscaling triggers for the demo tag.

simon: I'll draft a terraform PR to import the vendor allocation when the SA is available: `terraform import acme_alloc.ALLOC-2091 ALLOC-2091` and add mapping to `module.demo-cluster.service_accounts`.

maria: Vendor replied with SA email vendor-sa@acmecloud.com — starting onboarding flow. Will update once the allocation appears in `gcloud`.

leo: Quick reminder — if vendor SA originates from different IP ranges, we need to open firewall for their CIDR (example: 35.200.0.0/14). Please include in firewall ticket.

maria: Opening firewall ticket now. Thanks all :thumbsup:

vendor-bot: Allocation ALLOC-2091 status changed to 'project-bound' at 1728516000."
